svg.title: OSCILLO-FIGHT HEXARENA
svg.desc: Vector fighting game, best of 3 rounds, six muscular humanoid fighters each with unique polygon bodies, unique normal chains and a signature RT special with dedicated particle VFX. Full dual gamepad, keyboard and touch console flow.

g.text: PAD : A KICK / B PUNCH / X DEF / Y JUMP-ATK / RT SIGNATURE SP / LT SP2
PAD : DPAD+STICK MOVE / VIEW CAM / MENU START+PAUSE / LB-LT 2P JOIN
KEY P1 : WASD MOVE / J PUNCH / K KICK / L DEF / I+SPACE JUMP-ATK
KEY P1 : U SP1 / O SP2 / V VIEW / P PAUSE / ENTER START / T TOUCH
KEY P2 : ARROWS / N M , . / NPAD 1-6 (2P SHARED KEYBOARD)
MATCH : BEST OF 3 // 6 FIGHTERS // EACH RT SPECIAL IS UNIQUE
XY RAW MAP // TRIPLE BUFFER // DUAL PAD // MUSCLE RIG BUILD 5
PAD : A KICK / B PUNCH / X DEF / Y JUMP-ATK / RT SIGNATURE / LT SP2
PAD : MENU = START / VIEW = CAM / LB OR LT = 2 PLAYER VERSUS
KEYS : WASD MOVE / J K L I U O / V VIEW / P PAUSE / T TOUCH
ROSTER : VANGUARD-01 / GEAROX / VERMIL / KOLOSS / GHOST-9 / EMBERFANG
EVERY FIGHTER HAS A UNIQUE RT SIGNATURE SPECIAL + VFX
P1 : A/D CYCLE, J CONFIRM P2 : ARROWS CYCLE, N CONFIRM
